- **Dependency updates are configured through Renovate on the shared tpsdev-ai preset; Dependabot is retired.** Advisory fixes wait the same 7 days as every update (bunfig filters during resolution, except @types/node and typescript; frozen installs do not filter, and scripts/check-lockfile-release-age.mjs gates the committed lockfile), the whole pi runtime family is excluded, lockfile maintenance is off, and CodeQL's sub-actions update as one PR for every update type.
